[[Shatterstone (unique)|Shatterstone]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Wiseroot Shatterstone]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[The Eternal Grove (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Cold damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Water Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[Water Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Viridian Scepter]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Water Magic]] [[wand]]s:
**[[Destroyer Scepter]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Scepter]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Scepter]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Hale and Hearty]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Water Magic]] [[wand]]s:
**[[Water Wand]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Scepter]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Rod]] from collector [[Zaishen Elemental Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Scepter]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Fan of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Scepter]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Scepter]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Scepter]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Scepter]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Scepter]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Scepter]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Wand Wrapping]] [[of Memory]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Hale and Hearty]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Flint's Wand]], [[The Stonebreaker (wand)|The Stonebreaker]], and [[Antiquated Rod]] have stats identical to this item.
*The [[Water Magic]] versions of the [[Deldrimor Scepter (unique)]], [[Golden Boar Scepter]], and [[Wayward Wand (unique)]] have stats identical to this item.
